patch_description: Cross-over of the two best-performing variants: keep the soft-min/soft-max smooth objective with analytic gradients and L-BFGS-B, the multi-start sphere-constrained search with beta escalation (20→60→150) and early break at the target squared ratio (~0.2404), then free-space refinement with sharper betas (60→150→400), and finally a greedy perturbation polish stage. Reuse precomputed triu indices per n for a small speed gain. This matches the configuration of the highest-scoring prior program (0.89) while staying within the timeout.
